post.description:
Queue a review of a PDF; it runs in the background, one review per GPU, whether or not the page stays open.

The review answers at most one form: a conference template (``conference_id``), a saved form (``review_form_id``)
or an uploaded UTF-8 text/Markdown file (``review_form``). ``gpu`` pins it to one GPU; omitted, it takes the first
free one. ``vlm``: vision model for figures (omitted: server default; ``none`` skips). ``related``/``sources``:
search for related work (omitted: ``SIBYL_RELATED_WORK`` / ``SIBYL_RELATED_WORK_SOURCES``). ``detail``/``mode``:
review length and generation mode (omitted: ``SIBYL_REVIEW_DETAIL`` / ``SIBYL_REVIEW_MODE``).

get.description: One queued, running or finished review.

delete.description: Cancel a queued or running review, or dismiss a finished one; only its owner (or an admin) may.

AvailableModel.title: AvailableModel
AvailableModel.description: A model the engine can download.

ChoiceOption.title: ChoiceOption
ChoiceOption.description: One level of a rating scale.

ConferenceDetail.title: ConferenceDetail
ConferenceDetail.description: A conference template with its questions and the form rendered as Markdown.

ConferenceSummary.title: ConferenceSummary
ConferenceSummary.description: A conference template, without its questions.

DeletedForm.title: DeletedForm
DeletedForm.description: Confirmation of a deleted review form.

DeletedReviews.title: DeletedReviews
DeletedReviews.description: Result of deleting all the reviews the user may delete.

EngineInfo.title: EngineInfo
EngineInfo.description: The active inference engine and the machine it runs on. ``gpus`` and ``servers`` are set by vLLM only.

FullReview.title: FullReview
FullReview.description: A stored review with its full criteria and the model's raw output.

Health.title: Health
Health.description: Service health. ``storage_count`` is set when healthy, ``error`` when not.

InstalledModel.title: InstalledModel
InstalledModel.description: A model downloaded into the engine.

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description: A username and password for the server's own accounts.

ModelTags.title: ModelTags
ModelTags.description: Downloadable size variants of a catalog model.

excludes.title: Excludes
excludes.description: What does not count towards the limit, e.g. 'references and appendices'

note.title: Note
note.description: Other paper types or caps, e.g. 'short papers: 4 pages'

edition.title: Edition
edition.description: Edition whose call for papers states the limit

PageLimit.title: PageLimit
PageLimit.description: How long a submission may be, from the conference's call for papers.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: A single question of a reviewer form.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: Citation key used in the review, e.g. R1

relation.title: Relation
relation.description: How the paper relates to the submission, written by the model

RelatedPaper.title: RelatedPaper
RelatedPaper.description: A paper found by literature search (arXiv, Semantic Scholar) and judged relevant to the submission.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Model for a stored review with metadata.

mode.description: Mode actually used; a custom form is always reviewed in a single pass

context_length.title: Context Length
context_length.description: Context window in tokens; the review could use all of it left after the prompt

paper_truncated.title: Paper Truncated
paper_truncated.description: The end of the paper was trimmed to fit the context

generation_calls.title: Generation Calls
generation_calls.description: Number of model calls that wrote the review

review_form_name.title: Review Form Name
review_form_name.description: Name of the custom review form

vlm_model.title: Vlm Model
vlm_model.description: Vision model chosen to describe figures, or null when the step was off

related_work.title: Related Work
related_work.description: Related-work search (arXiv, Semantic Scholar) was enabled

gpu.title: Gpu
gpu.description: GPU index the review was requested on, or null for automatic

duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds
duration_seconds.description: Time from PDF parsing to the finished review

ReviewConfig.title: ReviewConfig
ReviewConfig.description: Settings used to produce a review. Reviews saved by older versions have none.

ReviewCriteria.title: ReviewCriteria
ReviewCriteria.description: A review's assessment, as stored. Loosely typed so reviews saved by older versions still load.

ReviewDetail.title: ReviewDetail
ReviewDetail.description:
How long and thorough the review should be. Steers the model through the prompt; never a token limit.

``auto`` gives no length guidance at all: the model decides.

ReviewJob.title: ReviewJob
ReviewJob.description: A review submitted to the queue. It runs on the server whether or not anyone has the page open.

ReviewJobList.title: ReviewJobList
ReviewJobList.description: Every queued and running review (anyone's), and the signed-in user's finished ones.

ReviewMode.title: ReviewMode
ReviewMode.description: ``single``: the whole review in one generation. ``sections``: one generation per section, then the scores.

ReviewResult.title: ReviewResult
ReviewResult.description: One model's review of the paper, as sent when the review completes.

ReviewResults.title: ReviewResults
ReviewResults.description: The reviews produced by one review job.

ReviewStatistics.title: ReviewStatistics
ReviewStatistics.description: Aggregate counts over all stored reviews.

SavedFormDetail.title: SavedFormDetail
SavedFormDetail.description: A saved review form with its text.

SavedFormSummary.title: SavedFormSummary
SavedFormSummary.description: A saved review form, without its text.

SearchRequest.title: SearchRequest
SearchRequest.description: Request model for semantic review search.

SearchResults.title: SearchResults
SearchResults.description: Reviews ranked by semantic similarity to a query.

PullProgress.description:
A progress line from the engine while it downloads a model; the last one has status ``success``.

Engines may add their own fields (Ollama sends ``digest``), which are passed through.
PullProgress.title: PullProgress
